mike_s: Saw a big tail latency spike on eu-west yesterday around 09:12 — admission queue length jumped and we started 5xxing short requests. anyone else catch this?
priya_k: Yup. I pulled the p99 traces. Looks like sudden burst of long-context jobs from a single tenant that filled warm pool slots and blocked admission.
alex_t: Logs show batching stayed high for ~7m, then the admission token bucket drained and new requests queued. We also saw a network retry storm from our edge -> region link.
sam_g: Is this the same tenant that did the fine-tuning job last week? If so we might need routing policy changes (rate-limit long-context per tenant).
jordan_r: Not the same tenant. This was interactive gen traffic, ~20 concurrent streams with 8k context each. Costy.
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0822-03. Auto-scaling events: scale-up triggered at +2 GPUs, warm-pool filled at 1m 40s, scale stabilization reached.
lee_h: Quick note: our warm-pool prealloc_count is 3 in eu-west and scale_step is 2. When a burst >6 arrives we still hit admission backpressure until new instances are ready.
mike_s: Thinking out loud: two levers — increase warm-pool target (higher steady cost) OR change admission to degrade long-context requests (queue+reject heuristics) + hedging to faster-compatible variants. Thoughts?
priya_k: I'd prefer admission-based mitigation first. Proposed rules: 1) short-circuit requests >6k tokens to a slow-path with lower concurrency, 2) token-bucket per-tenant with refill tied to reserved capacity, 3) cap concurrent KV cache entries per model shard.
alex_t: Can we implement a burst limiter that looks like: ```
admission:
  type: token_bucket
  capacity: 2000
  refill_rate_per_sec: 50
  per_tenant: true
  priority_short_requests: true
```
sam_g: That config looks fine — but refill_rate and capacity need to be tuned by real traffic. We should also add a fast-fail threshold for queue depth > 300 to avoid cascading retries.
jordan_r: Also consider proactive hedging: if queue_time > 200ms, we can route to an fp16 quantized variant with faster throughput. Need to ensure quality monitoring catches regressions.
lee_h: Regional constraints: eu-west has one spare NIC per host, plus PCIe oversubscription we hit when starting extra GPUs. Spawning a lot at once increased placement failures, which delayed scale-up. So rate-limit instance spin-ups per rack to 1/min.
mike_s: Good point. Maybe change autoscaler to stagger spins across AZs and add a warm-pool hedge in a cheap flavor (smaller GPU or q4 model variant) so we don't always spin full V100s.
priya_k: I can prototype a canary policy: maintain warm-pool 2 x full-gpu + 2 x cheap-hedge (lower mem/quantized). If full-gpu usage > 80% for 5m, promote hedges or spin fulls.
sam_g: For admission metrics we need new gauges: queue_length_by_tenant, queue_time_p50/p95/p99, admission_denies_by_reason. Add those to console and alert at queue_time_p95 > 500ms for 5m.
alex_t: Also adding a dynamic scale multiplier: when queue_time_p95 climbs and GPU_util > 75% then increase predicted scale target by +30% instead of fixed steps. Combine with slot hedging so we don't overprovision.
lee_h: Cost callout: hedges will save $$ vs always raising warm-pool, but require extra routing logic. Ops: we should estimate cost delta for 1-week steady-state and for burst profile.
mike_s: Action items: Priya to draft admission + hedging config (canary) by EOD. Alex to add the 3 new metrics and a simple dashboard. Sam to run a load replay tomorrow with 2x burst to test. Jordan to validate quality on quantized hedges. Lee to update autoscaler to stagger spins per rack. I'll own rollout and monitoring.
priya_k: On it. I'll put the draft in #eng-infra and tag everyone.
sre-bot: Reminder: create canary rollout, max 10% of traffic, monitor queue_time_p95 and model_quality_regressions.
mike_s: Thanks. If anyone has a quick config suggestion or known safe defaults for token_bucket params, drop them here. Otherwise we implement and iterate canary tomorrow. :thumbsup:
alex_t: Default suggestion: capacity = 500 * num_hosts_in_pool, refill = 20/sec * num_hosts_in_pool, queue_fastfail = 350. Works as a starting point.
sam_g: I'll schedule the replay at 09:00 UTC tomorrow. Heads-up to SRE on standby.
jordan_r: I'll produce a small eval set to check hedged variants for drift.
lee_h: I'll PR the autoscaler staggering change and add a rate limit to instance-create jobs.
mike_s: Great. Closing loop tomorrow after canary. :rocket:
